items.name: Mushroom
items.description: Roll two dice and add them together.

items.name: Golden Mushroom
items.description: Roll three dice and add them together.

items.name: Custom Dice Block
items.description: Choose any number from 1 to 10 instead of rolling.

items.name: Magic Lamp
items.description: Your next star costs 10 coins less. Used automatically.

items.name: Crystal Ball
items.description: Shows you where the star goes next. Nobody else sees it.

items.name: Blue Shell
items.description: Blocks the next Coin Steal, Star Steal or Boo Bell against you. Used automatically.

mario-stadium.name: Launch Star
mario-stadium.description: Safety Without Power that must be played on another player and used within the first 12 hours of Tribal. The last time this can be used is at the F7 Tribal.

luigis-mansion.name: Poltergust 5000
luigis-mansion.description: Must be pre-played or used within the first 4 hours of Tribal. Notifies you WHEN each player votes and, after Tribal, who has voted for whom. This advantage does not expire.

warioware-inc.name: Garlic
warioware-inc.description: Lets you MUTINY to another tribe with Individual Immunity for your first episode there. Must be pre-played before an episode or within the first six hours of an episode.

waluigi-pinball.name: Bob-omb
waluigi-pinball.description: Played on another player to deflect their own vote onto themselves. If they have any form of Immunity, the self-vote is negated. The last time this can be used is at the F6 Tribal.
